_howto: Upload this file to the ROOT of github.com/Shreyas2006-oss/browser (Add file -> Upload files).
With it in place, shipping an update is: build, upload the installer somewhere with a direct link, edit this one file.
2. npm run dist                       (installer lands in dist/)
3. upload that .exe and copy its direct download link
4. set the fields below: version, url, file, size, notes
Silence picks it up within 6 hours on its own, or instantly via Settings -> Reset & about -> Check for updates.
Leave version equal to the installed version and nothing is offered (that is the state this file ships in).
